about: Nick Thorn Surf Coaching is a North Devon surf school at Putsborough, at the southern end of Woolacombe Bay, run by Level 4 master surf coach Nick Thorn. It has over 25 years' experience and teaches people aged 6 to 80. Alongside lessons, it hires surfboards, wetsuits and paddleboards, and runs SUP and coasteering at other beaches nearby.
offers: Surfboard hire, from soft beginner boards to hard performance boards
Surf lessons for beginners to advanced
Coasteering at Croyde and Hele Bay
Junior lifeguard and school group sessions
where: Putsborough, Woolacombe Bay; SUP also at Saunton, Croyde, Instow, Hele Bay, Combe Martin and Ilfracombe
goodToKnow: Book online or by phone; terms and conditions are on the website
Accredited with Surfing England and a lifeguard training centre
gaps: No season dates, lesson inclusions or cancellation terms
